items.title: php/php-src
items.summary: PHP is used as a general-purpose scripting language designed specifically for web development processes. Written in the C language, this interpreter forms the infrastructure for many websites around the world.

snapshot.description: The PHP Interpreter. PHP is a popular general-purpose scripting language that is especially suited to web development. Fast, flexible and pragmatic, PHP powers everything from your blog to the most popular websites in the world.

items.title: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
items.summary: The knowledge-work-plugins developed by Anthropic offer open-source (source code accessible to everyone) plugins for knowledge workers that run on Claude Cowork and Claude Code. These plugins structure the artificial intelligence model to provide expertise tailored to users' tasks, teams, and companies.

snapshot.description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork. Plugins that turn Claude into a specialist for your role, team, and company. Built for Claude Cowork, also compatible with Claude Code.

items.title: fastapi/fastapi
items.summary: FastAPI is a modern web framework that allows for the development of high-performance application programming interfaces (APIs) with the Python programming language. Based on standard Python type hints, it offers fast coding and production-ready solutions.

snapshot.description: FastAPI framework, high performance, easy to learn, fast to code, ready for production. FastAPI is a modern, fast (high-performance), web framework for building APIs with Python based on standard Python type hints.

items.title: luongnv89/claude-howto
items.summary: luongnv89/claude-howto offers a visual and example-oriented guide for the AI-powered coding tool Claude Code, ranging from basic concepts to advanced agent usage. It aims to accelerate development processes with templates that users can copy and paste directly.

snapshot.description: A visual, example-driven guide to Claude Code — from basic concepts to advanced agents, with copy-paste templates that bring immediate value.

items.title: Meloong-Git/PCL
items.summary: Meloong-Git/PCL is a project containing the source code for the tool called Plain Craft Launcher, used to launch the Minecraft game. Developed in Visual Basic .NET, this work includes core components such as the interface library, animation modules, and game launching processes.

snapshot.description: Minecraft 启动器 Plain Craft Launcher（PCL）。. 包含 PCL 的大部分源代码，包括 UI 库、动画模块、下载模块、Minecraft 启动模块等！ 代码并不是实时更新的，它会在每次 PCL 发布更新时同步一次。 非常感谢社区的大力支持！

items.title: Quad9 to exit France
items.summary: Quad9, a free domain name system (DNS) service, has decided to withdraw from the French market. The organization, which provides security and privacy-focused services, shared the reasons for this change on its official blog page.

snapshot.description: A public and free DNS service for a better security and privacy

items.title: eMudhra to exit global SSL/TLS certificate business
items.summary: Digital trust company eMudhra has announced that, following a decision by its board of directors, it will voluntarily withdraw from the global SSL/TLS certificate business. With this strategic change, the company aims to terminate its operations in this specific field of activity.

snapshot.description: eMudhra Limited (BSE: 543533 | NSE: EMUDHRA), a global digital trust company, today announced that its Board has decided to voluntarily withdraw from the global SSL/TLS certificate business.

items.title: Tell HN: I unknowingly broke the PHP RCE embargo. I am sorry.
items.summary: A user stated that they shared security vulnerabilities CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 regarding remote code execution flaws in the PHP programming language, violating the coordinated disclosure schedule. Expressing that this post caused disruptions in security processes and additional workload, the user took responsibility and apologized for the situation.

items.title: WorldTUI: I trained a 360M model to pretend to be a terminal
items.summary: WorldTUI is a 360-million parameter AI model that behaves like a terminal and can remember the user's previous actions. This work presents a model trained to mimic text-based command-line interfaces.

snapshot.description: A 360M model that pretends to be a terminal, and remembers what you did

items.title: Docker is weird
items.summary: Docker offers a critical perspective on the working principles and complexity of containerization technology. It examines the unusual structural features in the operation of this platform used in software development processes.

items.title: RecursiveSI/flint
items.summary: RecursiveSI/flint is a text generation model with a mixture-of-experts architecture developed for coding agents. Containing a total of 39.8 billion parameters, the model is designed for examining codebases, debugging, adding new features, and writing tests.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. Flint is Recursive’s mixture-of-experts language model for coding agents, with 39.8 billion total parameters and approximately 2.5 billion active per token. It is designed to investigate codebases, fix bugs, implement features, and write tests.

items.title: OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-Image-Base
items.summary: MOSS-Image-Base, developed by the OpenMOSS-Team, is an AI model with text-to-image generation capabilities. This model supports natural language prompts as well as tag sequences and structures in JSON format used to control text placement and object layout.

snapshot.description: text-to-image model. MOSS-Image-Base is the base text-to-image model in the MOSS-Image family from OpenMOSS. It supports natural-language prompts, tag sequences, and JSON layouts for controlling text placement and object arrangement.

items.title: MambaAct: Efficient Mamba Action Experts for Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: MambaAct is an action expert architecture developed to reduce inference costs in robotic manipulation models. It aims to facilitate real-time control by accelerating the iterative denoising process in flow-matching-based vision-language-action models.

snapshot.description: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong promise for generalist robotic manipulation, but their inference cost remains a major bottleneck for real-time control. This limitation is especially pronounced in flow-matching VLAs such as π_{0.5}, where the action expert is evaluated repeatedly during iterative denoising. items.title: SplatLab: Autonomous Scientific Discovery for 3DGS Research
items.summary: SplatLab is an AI system developed to automate scientific research in the field of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). By overcoming the limitations of existing systems, it offers an end-to-end workflow from research proposals to code writing.

snapshot.description: Reproducing a published 3DGS paper takes weeks of expert engineering before any extension can be proposed. Prior autonomous-research systems read papers, draft hypotheses, and write code, but are limited by short fixed templates, low executability, and weak traceability, and none has been demonstrated end-to-end in a live computer-vision subfield with intense activity. items.title: RTAformer: Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer for Video Scene Graph Generation
items.summary: RTAformer focuses on the task of video scene graph generation, which identifies objects within videos and the relationships between these objects that change over time. The model aims to reduce erroneous predictions seen in existing methods by simultaneously tracking the continuity of object identities and sudden changes in relationships.

snapshot.description: Video scene graph generation (VidSGG) aims to capture objects and their evolving relationships in videos. This requires accounting for both the persistence of object identities and abrupt changes in relationships. Existing methods aggregate information across frames to exploit temporal context, but an emphasis on consistency can obscure these changes. items.title: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
items.summary: IQuest-Q1, shared on Hugging Face, is a base model with a sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture containing 320 billion parameters. It has undergone a three-stage training process to enhance the capabilities of command-line interface (CLI) based agent systems.

snapshot.description: We present IQuest-Q1, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated). IQuest-Q1 is developed through a three-stage process: (1) stable and efficient pre-training, combining Stable SplitNorm, Muon, and muP with a two-stage curriculum whose second stage increases the coding-data mixture, preserving a wide stability margin between safe and optimal learning rates; (2) fine-grained mid-training, expanding the data mixture across domains and forma

items.title: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
items.summary: WeVisOne-VL is a vision-language model (VLM) that combines object- and pixel-level visual perception with a structured next-token prediction method. It supports various visual tasks such as object detection, optical character recognition (OCR), and segmentation, offering users the ability to perform localization at different levels of detail.

snapshot.description: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception. In this report, we present WeVisOne-VL (WeChat Vision All-in-One), a powerful VLM that unifies object-level and pixel-level perception through structured next-token prediction. It supports multiple visual tasks including object detection, referring localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting, enabling localization at any user-specific granularity, from points and boxes to masks and alpha matte

glossary.explanation: A type of programming language used to automate and accelerate complex software processes, generally designed for writing shorter and more practical code.
A technical method that converts the structure of code in a programming language into a hierarchical tree arrangement that a computer can understand.
A connection point that enables different software applications to exchange data with each other and perform operations through one another.
Code markers that help reduce errors by specifying the data type of variables during software development.
A system that translates website names into numerical addresses that allow computers to locate one another.
A critical vulnerability that allows attackers to exploit a security flaw in a system to remotely execute their own code on that system.
The process of keeping a security vulnerability confidential until the system owner takes precautions, followed by a planned public disclosure.
An interface that allows text-based commands to be sent directly to a computer.
A method that bundles all files and settings required for a software application to run into a single package, ensuring it operates identically in any environment.
An architecture that provides efficiency by dividing a large artificial intelligence model into smaller parts, each specialized in different subjects, and running only the relevant part.
Artificial intelligence technology that creates images suitable for text descriptions written by the user by analyzing them.
A specialized artificial intelligence architecture designed specifically to manage the movements of robotic systems and optimize their decisions.
A learning method that makes the path followed by artificial intelligence models while generating data mathematically faster and more stable.
